title: CLOSURE: Cross-Channel Closure for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series produced by industrial installations and server clusters are under continuous monitoring, and anomaly detection is the first line of defense before a local fault escalates into a system-wide failure. In the absence of labels, the dominant paradigm trains a reconstruction model on normal data and scores the residual to reach a verdict. Recent work has steadily enriched the expressiveness of the recovery map through Transformers, diffusion models, and cross-scale associations. A residual, however, only certifies that an observation can be recovered; it does not certify that the variables still explain one another as they do under normal operation. A coordinated yet unfamiliar operating transition inflates the residual without breaking any relationship, whereas a sensor drifting away from its peers may leave the residual silent. Methods that fold inter-variable dependencies into the reconstruction objective inherit

translated_title: CLOSURE：面向多元时间序列异常检测的跨通道闭合性
translated_abstract: 工业设备和服务器集群产生的多元时间序列处于持续监控之下，异常检测是在局部故障升级为系统性故障之前的第一道防线。在缺乏标签的情况下，主流范式是在正常数据上训练重构模型，并通过对残差打分来做出判断。近期研究通过 Transformer、扩散模型和跨尺度关联不断提升恢复映射的表达能力。然而，残差只能证明某个观测值可以被恢复，并不能证明各变量之间仍然像正常运行时那样相互解释。一种协调一致但陌生的运行状态变化会在不破坏任何关系的情况下使残差增大，而一个偏离其同伴的传感器漂移可能不会在残差中留下任何痕迹。将变量间依赖关系融入重构目标的方法继承了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CLOSURE方法，通过跨通道闭合性检验各变量之间是否仍像正常运行时那样相互解释，弥补了单纯依赖重构残差无法捕捉变量间关系异常（如传感器漂移）的不足。
en_tdlr: CLOSURE introduces cross-channel closure, which verifies whether variables still explain one another as they do under normal operation, complementing reconstruction residuals to detect relationship-level anomalies (such as sensor drift) that residuals alone miss.
